blocks.text: Anne Hathaway has welcomed her third child with husband Adam Shulman. The actress was spotted in public with her newborn for the first time. According to photos obtained by TMZ, Hathaway was seen walking around New York City on Tuesday, Nov. 17, with her newborn strapped to her chest in a front-facing baby carrier while chatting with a female friend during the stroll. The actress appeared in a casual outfit, wearing a long gray coat, a brown baseball cap, sunglasses and light-colored pants.
